claims: Wake Forest was the top seed.
The game was in the 2026 NIT second round.

Illinois State rallied from a nine-point second-half deficit.
The victory marks Illinois State's first multi-win NIT performance in 30 years.
The game location was Winston-Salem, N.C.
The game was on Wake Forest's home court.
Johnny Kinziger scored 19 points for Illinois State.
Johnny Kinziger had 5 assists for Illinois State.

Illinois State advances to the NIT quarterfinals.
Illinois State is scheduled to play No. 2 seed Dayton in the NIT quarterfinals.
